name: audio_isolate
description: Audio isolation / cleanup (ElevenLabs): strips background noise and music, keeping only the voice. Requires at least 4.6s of audio.

audioUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier` to clean up. Must be at least 4.6 seconds long.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
